tester: <the QA person's display name, as the tracker shows it>

tracker.label: <the team's label>
tracker.board_jql: project = <KEY> AND labels = <label> AND sprint in openSprints() AND statusCategory != Done
tracker.overdue_jql: project = <KEY> AND labels = <label> AND duedate < now() AND statusCategory != Done
tracker.release_jql: project = <KEY> AND fixVersion = "<release>" AND statusCategory != Done

hints: <the workspace's own rules, one line each, e.g. "<KEY>-123 is not ours: ignore it">
